title: Q-STD-slsa: attest each Worker deploy with SLSA build provenance
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --adopted slsa
**Status:** open

Each deploy row in ops/deploys.jsonl already names the commit and the live version, and actions are pinned by commit (foundation/actionpins.py). Add the signed form: the site Worker's deploy endpoint (site/deployer.js) returns the SHA-256 of the bundle it uploaded; the deploying workflow writes a build-provenance attestation for that digest with GitHub's attestation service on the run's own OIDC token (permissions `id-token: write`, `attestations: write`; the action pinned by commit SHA); the deploy row records the attestation id. No stored credential and nothing added to any Worker. Detector: a deploy row from Actions without an attestation id.

STANDARDS-FIRST-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): "Standards, don't reinvent the wheel. Apply standards." The row is `slsa` in seed/standards/standards.json; this item closes when that row reads `"adoption": "adopted"` and every probe on it passes. Change the row in the same change that makes it true, never before.
